canaries.text: **Scope note:** `/slim` is supported for vanilla/direct usage in this release. The framework bindings (`@comvi/vue`, `@comvi/react`, `@comvi/solid`, `@comvi/svelte`, `@comvi/next`, `@comvi/nuxt`) require a full root `@comvi/core` instance; passing a slim instance is neither type-supported nor tested. The measured sizes below are the core entry alone, not total framework-app weight.
